method: Selected top-level functions only; exact source after blank/comment-only line removal, tab expansion, and trailing-whitespace normalization; no identifier renaming; minimum eight retained lines. Not semantic equivalence or whole-project duplication coverage.

repository_inventory.method: git ls-tree -r -l -z at source_commit; includes evidence, assets, generated files and source; not a line-by-line review

application_scan.method: All tracked app/**/*.gd except app/tests and app/assets; top-level functions only; exact source after removing blank/comment-only lines, expanding tabs to four spaces and trimming trailing whitespace; signatures retained; no identifier normalization; minimum eight retained lines; not semantic equivalence or deletion proof.

whole_file_comparisons.method: Equal Git blob IDs, code extensions gd/py/cpp/h/js/ts/mjs/sh/ps1, at least300bytes; excluded docs, external Audits, vendored .claude/.agents and assets/source-deliveries; not a complete binary/data duplicate scan

groups.interpretation: Candidate evidence only; active consumers, generated roles and historical identities must be checked before retirement.
